scope: Read-only static join: official ID snapshot, current typed source assignments/build coverage, exact closed archive index; no package installation or runtime qualification
current_binding_limits: Only root placement and condition owner_state are sent; an empty legacy binding_owners deliberately hides undisclosed Web input.

EffectPackage.set_input cannot supply dynamic inputs to a recorded occurrence without an occurrence node; inspect the selected approach contract rather than assuming recorded particles can reproduce actor/item/membership-dependent programs.
targets is declared by simple condition markers even when their runtime receiving adapter is absent; owner_root grouping is not a claim that every declared target packet is operationally required.
Current material registration falls back from absent head sockets to body center and has no recipient_weapon registration; generic ownership calls are not complete anchor qualification.
Legacy action media-ID to native_source dispatch does not select the new package class programs. Reuse existing PresentationEffectUse for authored action cues; do not introduce a parallel language.
Source/build ready labels do not establish actual inputs, visible output, frame cost, audio playback or human acceptance.

public_mapping_rule: These are not in public ConditionState. Prove exact disclosure elsewhere for each selected variant; otherwise report unavailable input. Do not infer private gameplay or manufacture events.
alternative_policy: Unselected Factory alternatives and fixture hints are inspectable candidates, not additional official gameplay requirements; fixture values are never runtime inputs.
limits: Text-resource cue extraction is a static source join; current native_staging, excluded probe and explicit cue fields are recorded. Runtime conditions/variants still require actual selection and output checks.
No visual acceptance, provider readiness or safety result is inferred from a build ready label or source resource reference.
